##### Project general facts

VYE is a progressive, forward-thinking community designed by internationally renowned architects for young families and like-minded residents. It brings together apartments in the Nova and Neo districts with SOL Homes, a collection of solar-powered townhouses and twin homes in minimalistic and Arabian-inspired designs, all connected by green corridors and pedestrian routes.

Nova Park forms a central green belt with picnic areas, gathering spaces and a children's playground, while The Walk offers a long landscaped pedestrian and cycling route across the community and The Drive provides a scenic green road linking every zone. The Clubhouse by Club S features a gym, wellness centre, tennis courts, sports fields and cycling tracks, and the VYE Town Center offers flexible offices and event spaces alongside a convenience store, nursery, pharmacy and clinics within walking distance.

Homes come semi-finished, giving owners the freedom to complete the interiors to their own taste. Townhouses and twin homes feature family living rooms, nanny rooms, outdoor terraces and private gardens, with selected layouts adding studies and roof terraces, while apartments offer open reception and dining areas, terraces and gardens for ground-floor units. Solar power and energy-efficient infrastructure run throughout the community.

##### Parking

Private parking.

##### Location description and benefits

New Zayed is a fast-growing district in West Cairo, set beside Sheikh Zayed City and close to SODIC West, combining a calm residential setting with direct access to the main road network. The area sits along the Dabaa Corridor and the Rod El Farag Axis, with the Cairo–Alexandria Desert Road close by.

Sphinx International Airport is within easy reach, and Downtown Cairo, Sheikh Zayed and the established schools, hospitals, malls and dining of West Cairo are close by. The surrounding area offers a growing choice of shopping, education and leisure destinations.

West Cairo is one of the most sought-after residential markets in the country, supported by new infrastructure and strong demand from families relocating from central Cairo. The area appeals to both end users and investors seeking long-term capital growth and rental demand.
